title: ornithogalum umbellatum var. baeticum
intro: Ornithogalum umbellatum var. baeticum, commonly known as Star of Bethlehem, is a plant species native to the Iberian Peninsula. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include sedative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum umbellatum var. baeticum include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
